boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UAH spaces for studying, making, viewing art, meeting, and taking a break, each supported by a direct university source.

cards.title: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.subtitle: UAH campus · 4700 Holmes Ave.
cards.notes: Start here when your group needs a flexible campus base: the library combines research help, group rooms, specialty labs, A/V areas, and printing.
cards.short_summary: A central academic building with several kinds of student workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Salmon Library supports students with reference assistance, instruction, group study rooms, A/V areas, printing, specialty labs, and more.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Use during library operating hours; particular services and rooms may have separate rules.

cards.title: Book a Salmon Library study room
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Reserve a room for a focused group session, then collect it at User Services with matching photo ID; walk-ups are first come, first served.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group and smaller study rooms with practical collaboration equipment.
cards.evidence_claim: The library lists five group study rooms and eight smaller rooms; group rooms include a table, chairs, whiteboard, computer, and wall-mounted monitor.
cards.access_notes: Reservations require a UAH email; checkouts are up to three hours, with renewal only if nobody is waiting.

cards.entity_name: M. Louis Salmon Library Sensory Space
cards.title: Take a reset in the Sensory Space
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use this quiet, semi-private room for a calm break from study or research; take a door pass, keep voices low, and leave supplies in place.
cards.short_summary: A regulated room for sensory regulation, relaxation, meditation, or stretching.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes the Sensory Space as a quiet and semi-private environment for regulation, relaxation, meditation, stretching, and other calming activities.
cards.source_title: M. Louis Salmon Library: Sensory Space | UAH Library
cards.access_notes: For current UAH students, faculty, and staff; maximum eight people, with visits normally limited to one hour.

cards.entity_name: M. Louis Salmon Library MultiMaker Lab
cards.title: Make and rehearse at the MultiMaker Lab
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Plan a creation session for a presentation, audio, video, or prototype, and check the lab’s equipment and reservation guidance before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A library creation space for making, recording, and presentation practice.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says the MultiMaker Lab provides equipment, software, and space for students, faculty, and researchers to create, record, or practice presentations and media.
cards.source_title: M. Louis Salmon Library MultiMaker Lab Policy | UAH Library
cards.access_notes: Lab computers are available to current UAH students, faculty, and staff; equipment and room use follow library policies.

cards.title: See what is showing in Salmon Library Gallery
cards.subtitle: First floor of M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Build in a short art stop while you are already in the library: the gallery sits by the coffee shop and hosts changing campus-connected shows.
cards.short_summary: An open-plan first-floor gallery integrated into the library’s daily flow.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies Salmon Library Gallery as a first-floor, open-plan space next to the coffee shop that presents group shows and BA Exit Shows.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Exhibitions change; check the gallery or UAH arts listings before making a special trip.

cards.title: Pair a study block with Student Success Center help
cards.subtitle: First floor of M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Use the center when a course calls for more structure: ask about tutoring, academic coaching, PASS, or writing tutoring alongside your study plan.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support center located inside Salmon Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH lists peer-assisted study sessions, academic coaching, content tutoring, online tutoring, and writing tutoring among the Student Success Center’s programs.
cards.source_title: Success Spots at UAH | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: The cited UAH page places the center on Salmon Library’s first floor; confirm current service availability before visiting.

cards.title: Take a game-room study break
cards.subtitle: Charger Union
cards.notes: When you need to step away from coursework, head to the Game Room for pool or table tennis, then return to your work with a clearer head.
cards.short_summary: A Charger Union recreation room for pool and table tennis.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says students can play pool or table tennis on the Game Room’s tables when taking a break from studying.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Located in the Charger Union; facility hours and any activity availability can vary.

cards.title: Check the CU Theater calendar
cards.subtitle: Charger Union
cards.notes: Watch for a campus presentation or Cinema Sunday showing in this purpose-built theater; confirm the event listing and entry details before you go.
cards.short_summary: A 332-seat campus theater used for presentations and movies.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes the CU Theater as a 332-seat venue with a 28-foot screen and Dolby surround sound, used for presentations and Cinema Sunday movies.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Programming and admission conditions depend on the individual event; consult its listing.

cards.title: Meet on the Theater Bridge
cards.subtitle: Between Charger Union and CU Theater
cards.notes: Use the bridge’s tables and chairs as a practical meet-up point before an event or as a short outdoor-adjacent pause between campus errands.
cards.short_summary: A furnished connector between the union, theater, and Greenway.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says the Theater Bridge connects the Charger Union and CU Theater, crosses over the Greenway, and has tables and chairs for students to hang out.
cards.source_title: Charger Union | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Access follows Charger Union and event-area operations; use the route without blocking pedestrian traffic.

cards.title: Visit Union Grove Gallery between classes
cards.subtitle: UAH campus
cards.notes: Check the current exhibition or arrange a visit for this historic gallery, then spend time with student installations, traditional shows, or campus events.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic building used for art exhibitions, meetings, and events.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Union Grove Gallery has continuously served as an art gallery since the 1970s and also hosts campus meetings, events, traditional exhibitions, and graduating student exit shows.
cards.source_title: Union Grove Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: UAH lists weekday-afternoon and appointment access; verify exhibition and visitor details before going.
